panels.title: Token activity today
panels.description: Calculated from observed request metadata; demo data remains explicitly selectable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(input+output+cache_read+cache_write),0) AS tokens FROM request_usage WHERE time>=date_trunc('day',now(),'UTC') AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}))

panels.title: Task duration
panels.description: Calculated from observed request metadata; demo data remains explicitly selectable.

targets.rawSql: SELECT project,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ((data->>'completed_at')::timestamptz-started_at::timestamptz)) AS duration_seconds FROM tasks WHERE data->>'completed_at' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(started_at::timestamptz) AND ('${data}'='all' OR (data->>'demo')::boolean=('${data}'='demo'))

panels.title: 5h quota history · source labeled
panels.description: Manual/official/estimated/experimental are evidence sources. These are account windows, not token counters.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time,provider||'/'||account||'/'||source AS metric,used_percent AS value FROM quota_history WHERE "window"='5h' AND $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) ORDER BY time

panels.title: 5h delta per task · percentage points
panels.description: Delta is in percentage points. NULL represents a reset crossing; concurrent tasks can contribute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT project,id,source_before,source_after,before_used,after_used,delta_pp FROM task_quota_deltas WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo'))

SELECT provider, CASE WHEN count(*)=count(estimated_api_cost) THEN sum(estimated_api_cost) END AS complete_usd, sum(priced_partial_cost) AS priced_partial_usd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_api_cost IS NULL) AS incomplete_calls FROM request_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) GROUP BY provider

SELECT agent, CASE WHEN count(*)=count(estimated_api_cost) THEN sum(estimated_api_cost) END AS complete_usd, sum(priced_partial_cost) AS priced_partial_usd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE estimated_api_cost IS NULL) AS incomplete_calls FROM request_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) GROUP BY agent

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time,'1h'), sum(priced_partial_cost) AS priced_components_usd FROM request_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT pricing_confidence, count(*) AS calls FROM request_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) GROUP BY pricing_confidence

SELECT provider, model, count(*) AS incomplete_calls FROM request_usage WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) AND estimated_api_cost IS NULL GROUP BY provider, model

SELECT sum((c->>'subtotal')::numeric) AS priced_usd FROM request_usage, LATERAL json_array_elements(cost_components) c WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) AND c->>'metric'='cache_read'

SELECT sum((c->>'subtotal')::numeric) AS priced_usd FROM request_usage, LATERAL json_array_elements(cost_components) c WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('${data}'='all' OR demo=('${data}'='demo')) AND ('__all' IN (${client:sqlstring}) OR client_id IN (${client:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${provider:sqlstring}) OR provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR model IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${project:sqlstring}) OR project IN (${project:sqlstring})) AND ('__all' IN (${agent:sqlstring}) OR agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})) AND c->>'metric'='cache_write'
